```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

joined <- open_dataset("data/history.parquet") |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_before_resolution = as.numeric(as_date(resolved_at) - date),
    time_bucket = case_when(
      days_before_resolution > 90 ~ "> 90 days",
      days_before_resolution > 30 ~ "30-90 days",
      days_before_resolution > 7  ~ "7-30 days",
      days_before_resolution >= 1 ~ "1-7 days",
      days_before_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c("> 90 days", "30-90 days", "7-30 days", "1-7 days", "Final day"))
  )
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  summarize(
    mean_error = mean(error),
    n = n(),
    .by = time_bucket
  ) |>
  arrange(time_bucket)

accuracy |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining until resolution",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_before_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(prob_bin = floor(probability * 10) / 10 + 0.05) |>
  summarize(
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n(),
    .by = prob_bin
  ) |>
  arrange(prob_bin)

calibration |>
  ggplot(aes(x = prob_bin, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day market probabilities closely track actual outcomes",
    subtitle = "Observed YES resolution rate vs. predicted probability on resolution day",
    x = "Predicted probability (10% bin midpoint)",
    y = "Actual YES resolution rate",
    size = "Markets"
  )
```
